action* (APPROVE|REJECT|HOLD|REQUEST_CHANGES|RESUME); comments mandatory for REJECT/REQUEST_CHANGES; expectedVersion optimistic lock

Multi-select review decision: applies the same action to version_ids* in ONE call instead of N × POST /:versionId/action. Shared input validation runs once (missing REJECT/HOLD/REQUEST_CHANGES reason 400s before anything is written); versions that cannot accept the action (already decided, ON_HOLD without RESUME, missing) are skipped with a per-id reason. ✅ 200 { applied: [{version_id, new_status}], skipped: [{version_id, reason}] }
Minimal unpaginated brand list for creative create/filter dropdowns: id, brand_name, industry_category, is_active. Optional ?search= (name) &activity=active|stopped. Full detail lives under Brands.

item.name: Adverts
item.description: Advert monitoring endpoints. Deployments originate upstream (intake); government side monitors and changes status.

request.description: Without lat/lng falls back to a plain filtered list.
7-day revisit window: this operator's recent searches, newest first.
Filters: status, brand_id/brandId, search, industry, dates, brand_status, city, zone, group_by=brand.
Returns text/csv attachment.
status* (SCHEDULED|LIVE|PAUSED|EXPIRED|REVOKED); expected_status optimistic lock (409 on stale)

Multi-select compliance status change: applies one status to every advert in `ids` in ONE call instead of N × PATCH /:id/status. Same per-advert optimistic-lock / flight-window rules; adverts that cannot accept the status are skipped with a per-id reason. Optional expected_status applies to every id — stale ones are skipped. ✅ 200 { applied: [{advert_id, status}], skipped: [{advert_id, reason}] }
status* (SCHEDULED|LIVE|PAUSED|EXPIRED|REVOKED); expected_status optimistic lock (409 on stale)

Single image-search endpoint. EITHER attach a file (multipart form-data, field name MUST be "image", PNG/JPEG, 5MB max — a present file always wins) OR send query params only: image_hash (16 hex chars) / advert_id plus optional max_distance/status/brand_id/page/limit. Needs one of the two, never a binary/raw body.

ids* — unarchive a selection at once

ids* — soft-archive a selection at once (documents tab multi-select): one call instead of N × DELETE /references/:id. Already-archived and missing ids are excluded from the write and reflected in the count. Accepted verbs: POST (canonical) and DELETE (REST alias), same JSON body. ✅ 200 { archived: N }

ids* — permanent delete of documents in ONE call instead of N × DELETE /references/:id/permanent. Same guard per doc (cannot delete a doc that justifies review decisions); blocked docs are skipped with a per-id reason. Accepted verbs: POST (canonical) and DELETE (REST alias), same JSON body. ✅ 200 { deleted: N, skipped: [{id, reason}] }
